title: El Nino knocking on the door as oceans warm rapidly, says UN weather body
description: World Meteorological Organisation sees 80% chance of El Nino by August; chances of the drought-bearing weather persisting beyond November exceed 90%
content: There is an 80 per cent chance of an El Nino event emerging between June and August 2026, with the chances of this continuing until at least November near or above 90 per cent, says the latest update… [+3581 chars]
de: El Nino klopft an die Tür, während sich die Ozeane schnell erwärmen, sagt das UN-Wettergremium. Die Weltorganisation für Meteorologie geht davon aus, dass die Wahrscheinlichkeit eines El Niño im August bei 80 % liegt. Die Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass die Dürreperiode über den November hinaus anhält, liegt bei über 90 %.
en: El Nino knocking on the door as oceans warm rapidly, says UN weather body. World Meteorological Organisation sees 80% chance of El Nino by August; chances of the drought-bearing weather persisting beyond November exceed 90%

title: The fish will die regardless: With some Western reservoirs set to run dry, officials lift fishing limits
description: Wildlife officials in Colorado and Oregon are allowing people to fish as much as as they want at some reservoirs that are expected to run dry because of drought.

en: The fish will die regardless: With some Western reservoirs set to run dry, officials lift fishing limits. Wildlife officials in Colorado and Oregon are allowing people to fish as much as as they want at some reservoirs that are expected to run dry because of drought.
la: Pisces neglegentes morientur: Cum nonnullis Occidentis piscinas ad siccitatem ponunt, magistratus limites piscandi levant. Magistratus truculenter in Colorado et Oregon permittunt homines piscibus tantum quantum volunt in quibusdam receptaculis quae propter siccitatem siccitatis expectatae sunt.

title: Earth’s east–west albedo symmetry
description: Analysis of a 25-year satellite record shows that Earth has a persistent east–west albedo symmetry split at 27° E, with clear-sky albedo, cloud radiative effect and open-ocean fraction exhibiting a triple symmetry around this meridian.

de: Ost-West-Albedosymmetrie der Erde. Die Analyse einer 25-jährigen Satellitenaufzeichnung zeigt, dass die Erde bei 27° E eine anhaltende Ost-West-Albedosymmetrieaufteilung aufweist, wobei die Albedo bei klarem Himmel, der Wolkenstrahlungseffekt und der Anteil im offenen Ozean eine dreifache Symmetrie um diesen Meridian aufweisen.
en: Earth’s east–west albedo symmetry. Analysis of a 25-year satellite record shows that Earth has a persistent east–west albedo symmetry split at 27° E, with clear-sky albedo, cloud radiative effect and open-ocean fraction exhibiting a triple symmetry around this meridian.
la: Terrae orientalis occidens albedo symmetria. Analysis de 25-anno satellite recordo ostendit Terram habere symmetriam orientis-occidentalem assiduam ad 27° E, cum albedo lucido, nubem radiative effectus et fractionem apertam exhibens triplicem symmetriam circa hunc meridianum.
